can you get a tax refund on skincare in Korea?

At many stores, the tax can come off right at the counter. Your receipt needs to be 15,000 won or more, and your passport is checked when you pay.

On-the-spot refunds work for purchases under 1 million won each, up to 5 million won in total. Those limits doubled in January 2024. Stores can set their own conditions, so ask before you pay.

Save this for your Seoul shopping day.

Sources: VisitKorea tax refund guide (updated Oct 2025), Korea.net (Nov 2023).
